title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E
author: Alexander S. Donahue, 0thernes LLC (ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
change_from_1_6_0: Built on top of frozen v1.6.0 (commit 1f028ea) following a comprehensive multi-layer repository, mathematical, Lean 4, software, and typesetting audit. Adds lean/HoggarBound/AuditUpgrades.lean (2,042 lines), expanding VerifyNewFormalizations.lean from 49 to 77 audited declarations strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]: asymptotic Filter.Tendsto 1/2 limits (Corollary A), Propositions 3 & 8 (quantum metric & Berry curvature), Proposition 10 (two-character hyperplane sums), signed-Clifford orbit transport, canonical Hermitian eigenvalue-multiset Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases, and Proposition 16' tightening Corollary 16's lower bound for sigma_1 from 315 to 330 via an exact zero-sum QUBO SDP dual (enclosures [347,368] and [330,344]). Extends scripts/conjecture_e_trace_formula.py to six qubits (39/39 checks, 136 total across n=3..6), adds scripts/c3_sdp_dual_check.py (15/15 checks), repairs Python script dependencies/warnings and wide TeX overflows, and synchronizes all documentation and legal disclosures without modifying any previously audited Lean module.
